description: For a complete consistent deductively closed propositional theory \(T\), \(v_T(A)=1\) exactly when \(A\in T\), for every shared formula \(A\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.complete_membership.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (T : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.Theory α)
  (_hT : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.IsClosed T)
  (hC : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.IsComplete T)
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.theoryValuation T) A =
      true ↔
    A ∈ T
